Game Overview

In Ogli Cats, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Ogli Cats, a captivating 2D platformer where the thrill of cookie collection meets daring escape. Navigate treacherous obstacles and strategize through eight increasingly challenging levels while deftly eluding the mischievous Ogli cats. With precision timing and double jumps, reach your feline haven unscathed.
